CustomField.description: Orders placed with this code that are being paid by check. Maintained by the Discount Code Check Redemptions rollup over Form__c; do not type in it. These orders have no Transaction__c and never will until somebody banks the check, so Times Redeemed - which counts paid transactions - cannot see them. Use Total Redemptions for the number that means "how many people have used this code".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check orders placed with this code. Maintained by a rollup; do not edit.
CustomField.label: Check Redemptions
